tools.name: get_daily_summary
tools.description: Returns saved daily targets, quantity-weighted logged calories and macros, signed remaining and explicit overages for a strict user-local YYYY-MM-DD date. Missing or invalid nutrition is incomplete, never zero-filled; unknown totals and remaining are null. One shared diary call. No recommendations o

tools.name: get_nutrition_targets
tools.description: Returns only saved daily calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber targets, with missing targets explicit. No recommendations or guessed goals. Requires meals:read and consumes one shared diary call.

tools.name: get_meals
tools.description: Returns a bounded page of the connected account’s private meals for a local calendar date, including persisted IDs and saved nutrition. When hasMore is true, nextAfterId is the afterId for the next page. Oversized entries are marked for checking in Enshape. Each page consumes one diary call.

tools.name: recent_foods
tools.description: Returns up to 50 recent private diary entries for the connected account, including their dates and saved nutrition.

tools.name: get_nearby_meal_suggestions
tools.description: Suggests meals at restaurants near coordinates supplied by the user, from meal combinations saved in Enshape, optionally filtered by query, maxCalories or minProtein. Returns at most 10 suggestions plus nearbyRestaurants chains within the radius with distance, saved nutrition, serving info, componen

tools.name: find_foods
tools.description: Searches Enshape by plain-language name or restaurant mention, without a location: verified restaurant menu items, reviewed restaurant combos (resolved automatically when a known chain appears in query or restaurant), plus the user’s own saved foods and recipes. Returns at most 10 items per page wit

tools.description: Returns up to 10 distinct foods the user logs most, from their newest 300 diary entries on or before a local date, ranked by meal slot (when given), how often and how recently, with the latest portion, saved per-serving nutrition and a diary ref for log_food_reference. tools.name: get_nutrition_trends
tools.description: Returns per-day logged totals for up to 31 user-local dates in one consistent read, with averages over complete logged days (count stated), target-hit days when daily targets are set, and the logged-day streak ending at endDate. Unknown values stay null and never become zero; unlogged days are not z

tools.name: update_nutrition_targets
tools.description: Changes only explicitly confirmed daily calories, protein, carbs, fat or fiber targets for the connected account. Omitted fields are preserved. Requires separate targets:write consent, at least one whole-number target, and confirmed:true. Returns the exact saved targets read back under the account l

tools.description: Creates one private diary entry for the connected account after the user confirms the portion, per-serving nutrition, local date and meal slot. Requires all five nutrition values and their source. Approved estimates are labeled. After an uncertain save, check the diary before retrying with the same

tools.name: log_food_reference
tools.description: Creates one confirmed private diary entry from a ref returned by find_foods (verified menu item, reviewed restaurant meal or the user’s own food), get_nearby_meal_suggestions (combo) or get_usual_meals, get_meals and recent_foods (diary entry); own foods and diary entries need meals:read too. tools.name: delete_meal
tools.description: Permanently deletes one private diary entry belonging to the connected account after the user explicitly confirms that exact entry. Use its saved diary ID from Enshape and verify ambiguous or stale entries before deleting. If the outcome is uncertain, check the diary before retrying with the same ID

tools.name: request_restaurant
tools.description: Stores a restaurant request in a private moderation inbox after explicit user confirmation. Requires restaurant name, a short message, and a stable requestId; optionally a coarse town or city. Never provide precise location, private contact details or diary content. Never creates restaurants or impo

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Returns server-verified Premium status, diary tool usage, remaining Free allowance, UTC reset time and request caps for the connected account. An unavailable entitlement check reports unknown, never Premium. This lookup does not consume the diary allowance and remains subject to request rate limits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_nearby_meal_suggestions · Private data: get_meals, recent_foods, log_meal, log_food_reference, delete_meal, request_restaurant · Public sink: request_restaurant · Destructive: delete_meal, get_account_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_nearby_meal_suggestions · Private data: get_meals, recent_foods, log_meal, log_food_reference, delete_meal, request_restaurant · Public sink: request_restaurant · Destructive: delete_meal, get_account_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
